svg.text: J1: dedicated 48 V / 5 A EPR sink. USB DATA is on J10; the two VBUS rails are separate.
U1: 48 V CC/VBUS and unused SBU protection. U2: TPS26750 EPR sink controller. U3: PD policy EEPROM. U4: hardware power-permit gate.
J1 D+/D-: not connected. Q1: protected VBUS control. Q2/Q3: PD-path level translation.
